profile.headline: Senior Software Architect
profile.summary:
With over 12 years of experience, I am a Senior Software Architect passionate about leading architecture, development, and developer enablement efforts across mobile, backend, and platform systems. My expertise lies in delivering performant, secure, and maintainable solutions, leveraging technologies like React Native, TypeScript, Go, and cloud-native tools.

Throughout my career, I've driven impactful transformations across retail, e-commerce, and IoT. My journey includes developing Total Wine & More's first React Native mobile app, helping it surpass 1 million downloads, and building a new loyalty program for Cava that drove customer retention and lifetime value. Most recently at Rockford Fosgate, I architected a stateless OOP library for the Rockford RFLink Protocol, handling mobile to BLE device communication. It relied heavily on SOLID principles, with functional sub-modules and state persisted in a consumer-owned Device object. I also reengineered the OTA firmware update pipeline through Azure, using Claude to redesign the architecture and authoring idempotent Python upload scripts for reliable, repeatable deployments.

What I focus on:
- Architecture that scales. I design React Native applications, reusable design systems, and stateless libraries built to handle complex device ecosystems and growing product demands.
- Making engineers' lives easier. I'm a hands-on mentor who builds tooling, sets testing standards, and helps teams adopt practices that actually improve how they work.
- Shipping production software. TypeScript, Go, Python, JavaScript. I've delivered high-volume, secure solutions across mobile and backend, and I care about code that holds up.
- Growing the people around me. I define architectural guidelines, foster collaboration, and mentor engineers at every level, because strong teams build strong systems.

I'm a hands-on technical leader who thrives on solving complex engineering challenges. I'm looking for impactful mobile, backend, or platform engineering roles, ideally remote or hybrid, with a collaborative culture.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working with the Embedded systems team to create intuitive mobile applications.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
• Reengineered the OTA download and upload pipeline through Azure, enabling end users to seamlessly update SREC firmware. Used Claude to completely redesign the Azure architecture, and authored idempotent Python upload scripts to ensure reliable, repeatable deployments.

• Designed and implemented AI-assisted development workflows using Claude; generated pin-code locking features across three repositories, wrote comprehensive test suites, and automated repetitive refactoring tasks. All architecture, planning, and critical decision-making remained human-led.

• Developed AI policies that augment and accelerate engineering skills rather than replacing human thinking; ensuring responsible and effective use of AI tooling.

• Architected and led development of React Native mobile applications, including RF Connect, enabling seamless device connectivity across Rockford's product ecosystem.

• Architected a robust BLE library using OOP with functional sub-modules to achieve a stateless architecture; all state stored in a 'Device' object persisted by the consumer.

• Designed a new RFLink Protocol library optimized for cloud extensions and future scalability.

• Created a reusable design system in React Native, enforcing brand consistency and accelerating feature development across multiple teams.

• Led the ground-up architecture of a new mobile app with industry-best navigation patterns and a highly maintainable, documented codebase.

• Designed and deployed experimentation and feature-flagging strategies for safe, data-driven rollouts.

• Championed agile transformation; mentored junior engineers through code reviews, design docs, and pair programming.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Partnered with the team at Cava to rollout of a new loyalty program, leveraging TypeScript, and React Native.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed Total Wine & More's first React Native mobile app, launching shopping lists, favorites, and In-Store Experience (ISE) mode; significantly boosting engagement and conversion.

• Designed and scaled backend microservices using Golang and Node.js for high-traffic e-commerce features and complex API integrations; containerized with Docker and orchestrated with Kubernetes.

• Integrated observability (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog) for distributed tracing and performance analysis; owned technical migrations of legacy services to modern microservice architectures with minimal downtime.

• Integrated third-party platforms (Adobe Analytics, Firebase, PayPal, Apple Wallet) for data instrumentation and secure transactions.

• Led full-stack rollout of a new loyalty program for Cava using React Native and TypeScript to drive retention.

• Streamlined CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows, reducing release friction and maintaining high availability.

• Collaborated with product managers, designers, and cross-functional teams to deliver customer-centric solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: TypeScript · Grafana · Jira · Splunk · Go (Programming Language) · React Native · React Native · Git · JavaScript

positions.title: Staff IT Engineer
positions.description: Under the Back Office Systems team I work with Dycom's subsidiaries to find out their technological needs. Then we will build or modify software to fit their use case.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Rapidly advanced from Intern to Staff Engineer, overseeing web scraping solutions and partner access systems.

• Built Python-based web scraping pipelines to extract contract details and load structured data for subsidiaries; architected a distributed scraping system using RabbitMQ to coordinate and scale parallelized data collection.

• Managed AWS infrastructure (EC2, S3, Lambda) for scalable and cost-effective operations.

• Designed, developed, and deployed mission-critical software implementations with corporate subsidiaries.

• Built distributed backend systems using Python, AngularJS, MongoDB, and RabbitMQ, ensuring scalability and reliability.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: The Frameworks and Tools team during this time did not have a senior developer. I started to take on the responsibilities of a senior engineering role. Along with my manager we started weekly sessions to teach our team about different topics. I would frequently be mentoring and helping other developers. I was also one of the initial architects for a partner access solution.  While on this team I also got experience with automating management of LDAP groups.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: The actual time spent working at Dycom for this position is 16 months. When I was in school I worked for Dycom on and off as an intern. During these years I worked with ruby on rails. I built a Django web application from conception to production. My team was whoever I could find to help. I also worked on the company's API for their master data repository.

positions.title: Student Technology Consultant
positions.description: I helped students when they came into the Office of Information Technology with computer problems and provide off-site tech support to the faculty and students. This would be consider help desk experience. I only worked this job during school semesters.

positions.title: TA for CSCI 134 - Introduction to Computer Science
positions.description: Work with the professors to help students in the class with their labs. This class is mainly focused on teaching the students through object orientated Java the fundamentals of programming.
